hints.title: Tile Periodicity
hints.text: Every square of sideLength x sideLength can be viewed as tiling the whole grid. Coordinate (r, c) shares relative tile position (r % sideLength, c % sideLength).

hints.title: Cell Multiplicity Weight
hints.text: Calculate how many times each position (i, j) within the sideLength x sideLength tile appears across the entire width x height grid.

hints.title: Greedy Top-K Selection
hints.text: Sort the appearance frequencies of all sideLength * sideLength positions in descending order. Take the sum of the top maxOnes frequencies.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying different 2D placement combinations across the full matrix is intractable.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Folding grid positions into equivalence classes reduces problem size from width * height to sideLength * sideLength.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize 2D modular equivalence and select the most frequently repeated relative coordinates greedily.
complexity.notes: Each relative position is repeated ((height - 1 - i) // sideLength + 1) * ((width - 1 - j) // sideLength + 1) times.
